southern_7th_Infantry_package.historical_anchor: 174 amphibian vehicles including 79 armored amphibians; 21-vehicle reserve; four LSTs configured for LVT repair support.
southern_7th_Infantry_package.transfer_guard: These vehicles remain tied to 7th Infantry/V Amphibious Corps recovery and are not the primary CATCHPOLE assault vehicle pool.

northern_4th_Marine_package.basis: Historical 4th Marine Division assault system contained almost 350 LVT(2)/LVT(A)(1)-class tractors across 4th/10th amtrac and armored-amphibian elements. Current Branch has not yet closed individual hull serials.
northern_4th_Marine_package.branch_note: The rerun does not inherit the historical extreme 10th Amtrac D-Day/D+1 control-fuel breakdown. Tarawa-derived traffic control and closer LST launch geometry reduce operational nonavailability, while Namur fire still produces real combat loss.

strategic_interpretation: FLINTLOCK leaves large numbers of assault LVTs recoverable, but their repair is not the main CATCHPOLE schedule gate because the reserve force has a distinct vehicle wallet.
